title: IT, Tech & Cyber Security
completion_message: ¡Formidable! En el mundo empresarial moderno, todas las empresas son empresas tecnológicas. Conocer términos como 'ransomware', 'encryption' y 'data breach' te permite interactuar con los equipos de TI y entender los riesgos digitales críticos.

parts.visual:
Riesgos de Ciberseguridad: 
- Data breach (Brecha de datos / Fuga de información confidencial). 
Ej: A massive data breach exposed millions of passwords. 
- Ransomware (Secuestro de datos / Software malicioso que bloquea el sistema hasta que se paga un rescate). 
Ej: The hospital's network was paralyzed by a ransomware attack. 
- Phishing (Suplantación de identidad / Engaño por correo para robar datos). 
Ej: Employees must be trained to recognize phishing emails.
parts.audio: Cybersecurity Risks. A 'Data breach' is an incident where confidential information is accessed without authorization. For example: A massive data breach exposed millions of passwords. 'Ransomware' is malicious software designed to block access to a computer system until a sum of money is paid. For example: The hospital's network was paralyzed by a ransomware attack. 'Phishing' is the fraudulent practice of sending emails pretending to be from reputable companies to steal personal information. For example: Employees must be trained to recognize phishing emails.

parts.visual:
Tecnología e Infraestructura: 
- Encryption (Cifrado/Encriptación / Proteger datos convirtiéndolos en código). 
Ej: End-to-end encryption ensures that our messages are secure. 
- Cloud computing (Computación en la nube / Servicios alojados en internet en lugar de servidores locales). 
Ej: We are migrating all our legacy systems to cloud computing. 
- Bandwidth (Ancho de banda / Capacidad de transmisión de datos). 
Ej: The video call failed because we didn't have enough bandwidth.
parts.audio: Technology and Infrastructure. 'Encryption' is the process of converting information or data into a code, especially to prevent unauthorized access. For example: End-to-end encryption ensures that our messages are secure. 'Cloud computing' is the practice of using a network of remote servers hosted on the internet to store, manage, and process data. For example: We are migrating all our legacy systems to cloud computing. 'Bandwidth' is the maximum rate of data transfer across a given path. For example: The video call failed because we didn't have enough bandwidth.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige el término tecnológico o de ciberseguridad correcto.

questions.question: An unauthorized access to confidential information is called a data ____. (Brecha / Fuga de datos).
questions.explanation: Data breach = brecha de seguridad / fuga de datos.

questions.question: Malware that encrypts your files and demands money to unlock them is called ____. (Secuestro de datos).
Sending fake emails to trick people into revealing their passwords is known as ____. (Suplantación de identidad).
questions.explanation: Phishing = correos fraudulentos para robar credenciales.

questions.question: The process of encoding data so that only authorized parties can read it is ____. (Cifrado / Encriptación).
Storing and accessing data and programs over the internet instead of your computer's hard drive is ____ computing.
questions.explanation: Cloud computing = computación en la nube.

questions.question: The amount of data that can be transmitted in a fixed amount of time is ____. (Ancho de banda).
Old computer systems or software that are still in use but outdated are called ____ systems.
A security system that monitors and controls incoming and outgoing network traffic based on security rules is a ____. (Cortafuegos).
Software that is intended to damage or disable computers and computer systems is generally called ____.
questions.explanation: Malware = software malicioso (incluye virus, ransomware, troyanos).

questions.question: When a system goes offline and is unavailable to users, it experiences ____. (Tiempo de inactividad).
questions.explanation: Downtime = tiempo de inactividad / caída del sistema.

questions.question: A small program that fixes a specific problem or vulnerability in software is a ____. (Parche).
A copy of data taken and stored elsewhere so it may be used to restore the original after a data loss is a ____. (Copia de seguridad).
A flaw or weakness in a computer system that hackers can exploit is a ____. (Vulnerabilidad).
A cyber attack where multiple compromised systems attack a target to overwhelm it with traffic is a ____ attack. (Ataque de denegación de servicio).
questions.explanation: DDoS (Distributed Denial of Service) = ataque distribuido de denegación de servicio.

questions.question: A private network connection that creates a secure tunnel over the public internet is a ____. (Red Privada Virtual).
Using two different forms of identification to access an account is called two-factor ____. (Autenticación).
questions.explanation: Two-factor authentication (2FA) = autenticación de dos factores.

questions.question: The process of moving data, applications, or other business elements to a cloud computing environment is cloud ____. (Migración).
questions.explanation: Cloud migration = migración a la nube.

questions.question: The time it takes for data to pass from one point on a network to another is ____. (Latencia).
A continuous process of software development where code is automatically built and tested is called Continuous ____ (CI). (Integración).
A methodology that combines software development (Dev) and IT operations (Ops) is called ____.
A data ____. (Brecha de datos con B)
A ____ attack. (Secuestro de datos con R)
A ____ email. (Suplantación con P)
End-to-end ____. (Cifrado con E)
____ computing. (Computación en la nube con C)
Not enough ____. (Ancho de banda con B)
____ systems. (Sistemas antiguos/heredados con L)
A security ____. (Cortafuegos con F)
System ____. (Tiempo de inactividad con D)
A software ____. (Parche con P)

pairs.target: Brecha de seguridad / Fuga de datos
Tiempo de inactividad / caída del sistema
